triggers.name: jenios_robot_r65_disable_only
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER jenios_robot_r65_disable_only BEFORE UPDATE OF generation_enabled ON public.jenios_robot_config_r64 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION jenios_robot_r65_disable_only()

triggers.name: jenios_robot_r65_guard_archive
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER jenios_robot_r65_guard_archive BEFORE UPDATE ON public.jenios_robot_archives_r65 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION jenios_robot_r65_guard_archive()

triggers.name: jenios_robot_r65_guard_cycle

rowCountsAndColumnGrants.indexInventoryQualification: The row-count query used a partial candidate selector; after.explicitIndexes is the authoritative complete source-derived inventory and confirms all eight explicit indexes. No schema change was needed between these reads.

explicitIndexes.indexdef: CREATE INDEX jenios_robot_archives_r65_scope ON public.jenios_robot_archives_r65 USING btree (scope_id, created_at DESC, archive_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX jenios_robot_cycles_r64_provider_response ON public.jenios_robot_cycles_r64 USING btree (provider_response_id) WHERE (provider_response_id IS NOT NULL)

CREATE INDEX jenios_robot_cycles_r64_reports ON public.jenios_robot_cycles_r64 USING btree (scope_id, period_key DESC) WHERE (state = ANY (ARRAY['COMPLETED'::text, 'NEEDS_RECONCILIATION'::text, 'DISPATCHED'::text]))

CREATE INDEX jenios_robot_private_observations_r71_period ON public.jenios_robot_private_observations_r71 USING btree (scope_id, source_id, captured_at_ms, event_id)

WITH relations AS (
 SELECT c.oid,c.relname,c.relkind,c.relrowsecurity,c.relforcerowsecurity,c.relacl,
   (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'notnull',a.attnotnull,'default',pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid)) ORDER BY a.attnum),'[]'::jsonb)
    FROM pg_attribute a LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid=a.attrelid AND d.adnum=a.attnum WHERE a.attrelid=c.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped) AS columns,
   (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid) ORDER BY k.conname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_constraint k WHERE k.conrelid=c.oid) AS constraints,
   (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid) ORDER BY i.indexrelid),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_index i WHERE i.indrelid=c.oid) AS indexes,
   (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid) ORDER BY t.tgname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_trigger t WHERE t.tgrelid=c.oid AND NOT t.tgisinternal) AS triggers,
   (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.polname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_policy p WHERE p.polrelid=c.oid) AS policies
 FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
 WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relkind IN('r','p','v','m','f') AND c.relname !~ '^jenios_robot_.*_r(64|65|67|71)$'
), functions AS (
 SELECT p.oid,p.oid::regprocedure::text AS signature,p.prosrc,p.probin,p.prorettype,p.provolatile,p.prosecdef,p.proconfig,p.proacl
 FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
 WHERE n.nspname='public' AND p.proname !~ '^jenios_robot_r(64|65|67|71)_'
)
SELECT clock_timestamp() AS observed_at,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM relations) AS preserved_relations,
 (SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.oid),'[]'::jsonb)::text,'UTF8')),'hex') FROM relations r) AS relation_catalog_sha256,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM functions) AS preserved_functions,
 (SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(f) ORDER BY f.oid),'[]'::jsonb)::text,'UTF8')),'hex') FROM functions f) AS function_catalog_sha256,
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',rolname,'bypass_rls',rolbypassrls) ORDER BY rolname) FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname IN('anon','authenticated','service_role')) AS managed_roles;

rels AS (SELECT e.name,c.oid,c.relrowsecurity,c.relforcerowsecurity FROM expected_tables e LEFT JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=to_regclass('public.'||e.name)),
fns AS (SELECT e.signature,e.body_sha256,p.oid,p.prosrc,p.prosecdef,p.proconfig,pg_get_function_result(p.oid) AS return_type FROM expected_functions e LEFT JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=to_regprocedure(e.signature))
SELECT clock_timestamp() AS observed_at,
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',name,'present',oid IS NOT NULL,'rls',relrowsecurity,
 'anon_access',CASE WHEN oid IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE has_table_privilege('anon',oid,'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE,REFERENCES,TRIGGER') OR has_any_column_privilege('anon',oid,'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,REFERENCES') END,
 'authenticated_access',CASE WHEN oid IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE has_table_privilege('authenticated',oid,'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE,REFERENCES,TRIGGER') OR has_any_column_privilege('authenticated',oid,'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,REFERENCES') END,
 'service_select',CASE WHEN oid IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE has_table_privilege('service_role',oid,'SELECT') END,
 'service_delete',CASE WHEN oid IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE has_table_privilege('service_role',oid,'DELETE') END,
 'service_truncate',CASE WHEN oid IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE has_table_privilege('service_role',oid,'TRUNCATE') END) ORDER BY name) FROM rels) AS tables,
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('signature',signature,'present',oid IS NOT NULL,'body_sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(prosrc,'UTF8')),'hex'),
 'body_matches',encode(sha256(convert_to(prosrc,'UTF8')),'hex')=body_sha256,'security_definer',prosecdef,'configuration',proconfig,'return_type',return_type,
 'anon_execute',CASE WHEN oid IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE has_function_privilege('anon',oid,'EXECUTE') END,
 'authenticated_execute',CASE WHEN oid IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE has_function_privilege('authenticated',oid,'EXECUTE') END,
 'service_execute',CASE WHEN oid IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE has_function_privilege('service_role',oid,'EXECUTE') END) ORDER BY signature) FROM fns) AS functions,
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',t.tgname,'table',c.relname,'enabled',t.tgenabled,'definition',pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid)) ORDER BY t.tgname)
 FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
 WHERE n.nspname='public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND t.tgname IN('jenios_robot_r65_guard_archive','jenios_robot_r65_disable_only','jenios_robot_r65_guard_cycle')) AS triggers,
 (SELECT jsonb_build_object('generation_enabled',generation_enabled,'requires_reconciliation',requires_reconciliation,'pricing_approved',pricing_approved,
 'allowed_model_count',cardinality(allowed_models),'max_request_nano_usd',max_request_nano_usd,'monthly_limit_nano_usd',monthly_limit_nano_usd) FROM public.jenios_robot_config_r64 WHERE singleton) AS initial_config,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM public.jenios_robot_budgets_r64) AS budget_rows;
